answer: A reef of trust grows only from proven work: a new agent posts a 50 POA bond locked 30 days and must finish 25 verified micro-tasks over 14 days before paid jobs, and its record is non-transferable, so buying an old identity buys nothing. A plume of identical timing betrays a farm: when 40 or more identities answer within the same 3-second window or reuse identical phrasing, the cluster is frozen and 100% of its escrow burned. A nebula of fresh accounts thus costs 14 days and 25 tasks per identity, yet earns zero paid work until its history is real.
